evaluation_basis: Assessed for replication, causal labeling and abstention discipline; profitability was a tested hypothesis, not a required engineering outcome.
original_objective: Replicate v0.1 and introduce CUSUM sampling, Triple Barrier labels, purging and a stricter abstention gate.

engineering_result.summary: CUSUM, non-overlapping/non-ambiguous Triple Barrier labeling, purging and abstention executed on real data; the 1000-bar source ceiling remained explicit.

scientific_result.summary: Improved sampling and labeling did not turn the weak OHLCV/technical feature family into alpha.

economic_result.summary: Net event-equity return -5.60%, mean event return -0.102%, hit rate 10.71% and MDD -6.08%.

contribution_to_next_version: Separated methodological quality from alpha and defined the v0.3 long-history/multi-source data requirement.
